capabilities: Add a daily note file node to a canvas
Update the node to today's daily note when the canvas opens
Optionally create the daily note file if missing, with per-weekday settings
Customize the node's appearance with CSS
disambiguation: Not a daily note creation tool; it only embeds a self-updating daily note node on canvases.
extras: The plugin only works on nodes it created (via unknownData metadata), and updating the node replaces it with a new one, so connections from the daily note node to other nodes are not supported.
intentEvidence: Add a daily note node to the canvas that will always show todays note.
problem: Obsidian's Canvas has no built-in way to place a self-updating daily note node on a board, so users must manually replace or relink the note each day.
summary: Canvas plugin that adds a file node showing today's daily note and keeps it pointing at the current day whenever the canvas opens.
